about: Actuator profile of the bimanual SO-101 rig: how the REAL servos behave, for sims / planners (joint limits, motor model) and for the tracking-correction layer at deployment (tracking.py). Kinematics and cameras are calibrated separately (cameras/so101_camera_rig.json).
units: joint degrees in the sim's convention = raw servo reading converted by so101_real.to_units, which already adds joint_offsets_deg; gripper 0 = shut .. 100 = open

servo_registers.note: read from all 6 servos of both arms on 2026-11-11 (identical); P 16 is LeRobot's soft setting (factory 32)

shortfall_deg.definition: commanded minus measured joint angle once the target has been still for ~0.8 s (positive = the joint stops short of a larger target)

poses.hover: tips ~11 cm above the table, 26 cm in front of the bases
poses.close: tips at table level beside the cube
poses.hold: holding a 15 g cube 4 cm up (load on shoulder_lift / elbow)

servo_registers.note: read from all 6 servos of both arms on 2026-11-11 (identical); P 16 is LeRobot's soft setting (factory 32)

shortfall_deg.definition: commanded minus measured joint angle once the target has been still for ~0.8 s (positive = the joint stops short of a larger target)

poses.hover: tips ~11 cm above the table, 26 cm in front of the bases

motor_model.about: MuJoCo position actuators fitted to the real arms on 2026-11-10 (kp, kv, forcerange, frictionloss, armature, timeconst per joint); joint-angle RMS 1.79 deg stock -> 0.52 deg fitted (left), 0.54 deg on the held-out right arm. It under-predicts the steady-state shortfall at full reach (sim ~1 deg vs real ~2.6 deg on elbow_flex).

evidence.2026-11-11 18:55 grab test, P16, no corr: tips stopped 10.7 / 11.6 mm short of their commands on each side (joints 1-3 deg short at ~25 cm reach); no squeeze force; cube not lifted
evidence.2026-11-11 19:13 grab test, P32 + correc: corrections up to 1.9 deg learned on the approach, frozen at the squeeze; cube lifted and put back
